question: is the published union coverage ratio a consistent pair of numbers?

published.defect: numerator is a SUM across channels; denominator is a DEDUPLICATED union. Cited units removed by the dedupe are still counted in the numerator.

frame_a_set_union.note: reproduces the populations the semantic probes sample

frame_b_containment.note: same rule as the published denominator, with the numerator reduced the same way; this is the fair repair of the published pair

input_drift.note: this rebuild differs from the published run by 16 units; the deltas above name the channel responsible. Reported, not hidden.

verdict: The published 8.0% is not a consistent ratio. The fair repair is 1938/43648 = 4.44% (set union) or 1891/43321 = 4.37% (containment). Per-channel and harness-only rows are unaffected: each uses one channel in both terms.
